edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. Keep former 辙叉 as a reverse-only alias in current; no intermediate edition.

rationale.approved: 2026-11-07 direct user adoption frog=轨叉, explicit keep top=帆楼. 轨 denotes rail/track and 叉 its crossing/branching shape. The established Chinese technical term 辙叉 is meaningful and correct, but the user chose sharing existing characters and 19-to-9 stroke reduction; dedicated 辙 removed, character types 2219 to 2218, no new character. Existing top=帆楼 keeps the high-place impression associated with English top. Greek combining -top-=境ᵀ remains distinct. No identifier or existing bare-key owner moves. Root spelling, original dictionary text, decomposition, glosses, JA/ZH/KO short annotations, markers and fixed original legacy remain unchanged. Only current edition display changes; inverse compatibility for prior 辙叉 can be handled separately, without an intermediate edition.

轨叉.policy: User permits shared-spelling ambiguity; do not change existing decomposition or identifiers.

migration_notice: Only current frog changes. The former 辙叉 key remains for reverse compatibility, including downloaded CSVs. Other owners and fixed legacy stay unchanged.
